services_intro: Airport transfers, a chauffeur for the day or an itinerary of your own. Explore the ways we can help you travel.
experience_body: Comfort, punctuality and discretion. Our professional chauffeurs bring their knowledge of London and the United Kingdom to every journey, with attention to your individual requirements.
fleet_intro: Mercedes-Benz saloons and spacious vehicles for business travel, private occasions, families and groups.
places_intro: Private tours shaped around your interests, time and preferences. Discover the city, or explore beyond it.
airport_title: An arrival to look forward to.
airport_intro: Private transfers to and from London’s airports and major private aviation terminals.
cta_body: A private transfer, a day with your chauffeur, or a journey beyond London. Tell us what you have in mind.
footer_description: Private transport, chauffeur services and personalised tours in London and throughout the United Kingdom.
name: Full name
form_intro: Leave your name, email address and telephone number. Our team will contact you to discuss your requirements.
form_note: Your enquiry starts a conversation. Journey arrangements and any payment are agreed directly with our team.
invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address.
invalid_phone: Please enter a telephone number with 6 to 20 digits.
received: Thank you. We have received your enquiry. Our team will be in touch.
try_again: We could not confirm receipt of your enquiry. Please try again or contact us by telephone or email.
process_title: From your first enquiry to your journey.
email_greeting: Thank you for contacting Londra Transfers.
email_body: We have received your enquiry. Our team will contact you to discuss your requirements.
email_disclaimer: This email acknowledges receipt of your enquiry. It does not confirm a transport booking.
privacy_email_hint: Use the email address used for your enquiry. We will send a verification link. This form does not confirm whether we hold any records for that address.
privacy_received: Your request has been received. Please check your email for a verification link. You can also contact info@londratransfers.co.uk.
privacy_verified: Your email address has been verified. Our team will review your request and contact you about the outcome.
privacy_expired: This verification link is no longer available. Please submit a new request or contact us directly.
privacy_verify_intro: Confirm that you control this email address so that we can review your deletion request.
privacy_email_alternative: To request deletion or exercise another privacy right, please email info@londratransfers.co.uk.
privacy_email_verify: We received a request to delete information associated with this email address. Please open the link below and confirm your email address within 48 hours. An administrator will then review the request. If you did not make this request, you can ignore this message.
privacy_email_admin: A verified data deletion request is awaiting administrator review. Open the protected administration record to review its deadline, identity and any lawful retention requirements.
privacy_email_complete: We have completed the review and erased the eligible website enquiry records covered by your request. Relevant mailbox and export copies have been reviewed. Any remaining backup copies are kept out of normal use and expire under the recorded backup schedule. A limited administrative record of the outcome is retained without your contact details.
privacy_email_decision: We have reviewed your request. The reason for retaining the relevant information is set out below.
privacy_decision_rights: You may ask us to reconsider or make a complaint to the UK Information Commissioner’s Office or the relevant European supervisory authority. Contact: info@londratransfers.co.uk.
offline_contact_intro: Speak with our team by telephone, email or WhatsApp about the journey you have in mind.
offline_contact_note: For enquiries and individual travel arrangements, please contact us directly.
planning_note: Discuss your itinerary, the number of guests and any luggage or accessibility requirements. We will talk through the arrangements with you.
related_vehicles: Explore the rest of our fleet.
fleet_notes: E-Class and S-Class for up to 3 guests, V-Class for up to 7 and Vito for up to 8. Please discuss luggage and individual requirements with our team.
faq_help_text: Every journey is different. Contact us to discuss your route, vehicle choice or individual requirements.
process_detail_1: Contact us with the journey or occasion you have in mind. We will discuss what you need.
process_detail_2: Talk through your itinerary, guest numbers, vehicle preference and any individual requirements.
process_detail_3: Agree the service details and fare directly with our team before your travel arrangements are confirmed.
partner_contact_intro: Tell us about your clients, destinations and transport requirements. Our team will discuss suitable arrangements with you.
